name: Potentially Suspicious EventLog Recon Activity Using Log Query Utilities
description:
Detects execution of different log query utilities and commands to search and dump the content of specific event logs or look for specific event IDs.
This technique is used by threat actors in order to extract sensitive information from events logs such as usernames, IP addresses, hostnames, etc.
author: GAI_CTI
false_positives: Legitimate usage of the utility by administrators to query the event log
query: ((process.command_line:(*Microsoft\-Windows\-PowerShell* OR *Microsoft\-Windows\-Security\-Auditing* OR *Microsoft\-Windows\-TerminalServices\-LocalSessionManager* OR *Microsoft\-Windows\-TerminalServices\-RemoteConnectionManager* OR *Microsoft\-Windows\-Windows\ Defender* OR *PowerShellCore* OR *Security* OR *Windows\ PowerShell*)) OR (process.command_line:(*\-InstanceId\ 462?* OR *.eventid\ \-eq\ 462?* OR *EventCode\=?462?* OR *EventIdentifier\=?462?* OR *System\[EventID\=462?\]* OR *\-InstanceId\ 4778* OR *.eventid\ \-eq\ 4778* OR *System\[EventID\=4778\]* OR *EventCode\=?4778?* OR *EventIdentifier\=?4778?* OR *\-InstanceId\ 25* OR *.eventid\ \-eq\ 25* OR *System\[EventID\=25\]* OR *EventCode\=?25?* OR *EventIdentifier\=?25?*))) AND ((process.command_line:*Select* AND process.command_line:*Win32_NTLogEvent*) OR ((process.executable:*\\wevtutil.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wevtutil.exe) AND (process.command_line:(*\ qe\ * OR *\ query\-events\ *))) OR ((process.executable:*\\wmic.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:wmic.exe) AND process.command_line:*\ ntevent*) OR (process.command_line:(*Get\-WinEvent\ * OR *get\-eventlog\ *)))
